_: Seam's two extensions, PINNED and shipped inside the package (installed from the package at first start — no network needed, no 'latest' from AMO at install time; Firefox updates them from AMO afterwards like any add-on). To bump: resolve https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/downloads/latest/<slug>/latest.xpi (follow the redirect to the versioned file), take its sha256, update version/url/sha256/file here, rebuild, run seam-selftest.
